instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
While the water is heating, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic.
Wash the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).

Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover. Working in batches if necessary, add salt and spinach, and stir until wilted, about 1 minute. Drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool (if cooking in batches, use tongs to transfer spinach to a colander). (Reserve pot for later use.)
Working in batches, take handfuls of the cooled spinach and use your hands to gently squeeze out any excess water. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
If necessary, wipe the pot clean with paper towels, then return to medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion, garlic, salt, and pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add softened cream cheese, cream, shredded cheese, and spices to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until cheeses melt and sauce thickens, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
16 fl oz heavy whipping cream
¾ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend
1 ½ tsp salt
1 tsp nutmeg, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach back to the pot and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
